regulatory_framework: Central Insecticides Board & Registration Committee (CIBRC) & ICAR-Indian Institute of Maize Research (IIMR)
verification_authority: Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine & Storage (PPQS) & ICAR-IIMR Guidelines
disclaimer: Pesticide recommendations are strictly rule-based and derived from verified CIBRC registered uses and official ICAR-IIMR extension advisories for India. Always verify local product availability, read the registered product label before use, and adhere strictly to specified Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), Pre-Harvest Intervals (PHI), and safety precautions.

symptom_distinction.en: Oval to elongated, cinnamon-brown to dark-brown pustules scattered across BOTH upper and lower leaf surfaces. Favors cool temperatures (16–25°C) and high humidity.
symptom_distinction.te: ఆకు పైభాగం మరియు అడుగు భాగం రెండింటిపై దాల్చిన చెక్క రంగు నుండి ముదురు గోధుమ రంగులో పొడుగుటి కురుపులు/మచ్చలు. చల్లని ఉష్ణోగ్రతలు (16-25°C) మరియు అధిక తేమలో వేగంగా వస్తుంది.
symptom_distinction.hi: पत्ती की दोनों सतहों (ऊपरी और निचली) पर दालचीनी जैसे भूरे रंग के उभरे हुए फफोले। यह ठंडे तापमान (16-25°C) और अधिक आर्द्रता में पनपता है।

chemical_interventions.verification_source: CIBRC Major Uses of Pesticides (Registered for Maize)
chemical_interventions.application_method: High-volume foliar spray covering both upper and lower leaf canopies.
chemical_interventions.application_timing: Initiate spray at the first appearance of pustules. Repeat after 10–14 days if cool, damp weather persists.
chemical_interventions.growth_stage_restrictions: Do not apply past the late dough / dent stage.
ppe_requirements: Wear N95 or equivalent dust/mist respirator mask
Wear safety goggles or face shield
Wear long-sleeved shirt, trousers, and rubber boots
chemical_interventions.environmental_precautions: Toxic to aquatic organisms. Do not spray near water bodies or during high wind conditions.

chemical_interventions.verification_source: CIBRC Registered Combination Products & ICAR-IIMR Protocol
chemical_interventions.application_method: Foliar spray with uniform canopy coverage.
chemical_interventions.application_timing: Apply when pustules are observed on ear leaf or leaves below ear prior to tasseling.
chemical_interventions.growth_stage_restrictions: Maximum 2 applications per crop cycle to prevent fungicide resistance development.
ppe_requirements: Wear particulate respirator and eye goggles
Wash hands and face thoroughly after handling
chemical_interventions.environmental_precautions: High toxicity to aquatic invertebrates. Prevent runoff into drainage channels.

integrated_disease_management: Select and plant resistant single-cross maize hybrids recommended by regional agricultural universities.
Avoid late planting; early sowing allows the crop to bypass peak cool-season rust sporulation.
Maintain balanced fertilizer application (avoid excessive nitrogen which promotes lush, susceptible tissue).
Deep plow crop residues after harvest to bury fungal overwintering inoculum.

symptom_distinction.en: Tiny, circular, golden-orange to light cinnamon-brown pustules, densely clustered PREDOMINANTLY on the UPPER leaf surface. Favors warm to hot temperatures (25–35°C) and prolonged high humidity.
symptom_distinction.te: చాలా చిన్నవి, గుండ్రని, బంగారు-నారింజ రంగు నుండి తేలికపాటి గోధుమ రంగు కురుపులు, ప్రధానంగా ఆకు పైభాగంలో మాత్రమే దట్టంగా ఉంటాయి. వెచ్చని/వేడి వాతావరణం (25-35°C) మరియు తేమలో వేగంగా వ్యాపిస్తుంది.
symptom_distinction.hi: छोटे, गोल, सुनहरे-नारंगी से हल्के दालचीनी रंग के फफोले, जो मुख्य रूप से पत्ती की केवल ऊपरी सतह पर घने रूप में पाए जाते हैं। यह गर्म तापमान (25-35°C) और अधिक नमी में अत्यंत तेजी से फैलता है।

chemical_interventions.verification_source: CIBRC & ICAR-IIMR Protocol for Severe Cereal Rusts
chemical_interventions.application_method: Thorough foliar spray targeted at upper canopy leaves.
chemical_interventions.application_timing: Southern rust is aggressive under high temperatures; apply promptly at first detection before pustules engulf the upper canopy.
chemical_interventions.growth_stage_restrictions: Do not apply within 21 days of grain harvest.
ppe_requirements: Wash equipment and wash contaminated clothes separately
chemical_interventions.environmental_precautions: Keep away from ponds, fish farms, and water reservoirs.

chemical_interventions.verification_source: ICAR-IIMR & State Agricultural Universities Extension Guidance (Pending direct standalone CIBRC maize label claim verification)
chemical_interventions.application_method: Foliar spray with fine droplet mist.
chemical_interventions.application_timing: Preventative or very early curative spray upon alert of regional southern rust arrival.
chemical_interventions.growth_stage_restrictions: Do not apply more than 2 sprays per season.
ppe_requirements: Full protective clothing, chemical apron, respirator, and gloves
chemical_interventions.environmental_precautions: Extremely toxic to aquatic life. Strictly observe buffer zones near water channels.

integrated_disease_management: Grow hybrids with genetic resistance (Rpp resistance genes) when planting in known southern-rust corridors.
Timely planting is critical: early-planted crops often mature before southern rust airborne spores arrive from warmer southern zones.
Daily scouting during tasseling and silking under warm, humid forecast windows (temp >27°C).
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation late in the afternoon to reduce night-time leaf wetness duration.

symptom_distinction.en: Long, elliptical, grayish-green to tan cigar-shaped lesions (2.5–15 cm long) with distinct margins. Favors moderate temperatures (18–27°C) and heavy dew.
symptom_distinction.te: సిగార్ ఆకారంలో పొడవాటి (2.5 - 15 సెం.మీ) బూడిద-గోధుమ రంగు మచ్చలు. మితమైన ఉష్ణోగ్రతలు (18-27°C) మరియు మంచు/తేమ ఉన్నప్పుడు ఎక్కువగా వస్తుంది.
symptom_distinction.hi: लंबे, सिगार के आकार के (2.5-15 सेमी) धूसर-भूरे रंग के बड़े धब्बे। यह 18-27°C तापमान और ओस/नमी में तेजी से बढ़ता है।

chemical_interventions.application_method: Foliar spray with uniform leaf coverage.
chemical_interventions.application_timing: Apply at first sign of cigar-shaped lesions on lower leaves.
chemical_interventions.growth_stage_restrictions: Do not spray within 20 days of harvest.
ppe_requirements: Wear protective gloves, face mask, and eye protection
chemical_interventions.environmental_precautions: Avoid spray drift into open waterways.

chemical_interventions.application_timing: Apply at early lesion development before blight ascends to the ear leaf.
ppe_requirements: Chemical-resistant gloves, protective eye goggles, dust/mist mask
chemical_interventions.environmental_precautions: Toxic to fish and aquatic life.

integrated_disease_management: Plant resistant maize hybrids certified by ICAR-IIMR or State Agricultural Universities.
Rotate fields with non-host crops (pulses, legumes, or oilseeds) for at least 1–2 cropping seasons.
Deep plowing of field stubble immediately after harvest to accelerate decomposition of overwintering fungal structures.
Ensure optimal plant density (60 cm × 20 cm) to facilitate sunlight penetration and rapid foliage drying.

disease_name.te: బూడిద రంగు మచ్చ తెగులు (గ్రే లీఫ్ స్పాట్)

symptom_distinction.en: Narrow, rectangular, block-like lesions with parallel sides strictly bounded by leaf veins. Favors warm temperatures (25–32°C) and persistent high relative humidity (>90%).
symptom_distinction.te: ఆకు ఈనెల మధ్య నిలువు వరుసలలో చతురస్రాకారపు/దీర్ఘచతురస్రాకారపు బూడిద రంగు మచ్చలు. వేడి వాతావరణం (25-32°C) మరియు అధిక తేమ (>90%) ఉన్నప్పుడు వ్యాపిస్తుంది.
symptom_distinction.hi: पत्ती की नसों के बीच सीमित, आयताकार भूरे-धूसर धब्बे। यह गर्म तापमान (25-32°C) और लगातार उच्च आर्द्रता (>90%) में फैलता है।

chemical_interventions.application_method: Foliar spray with motorized knapsack or tractor-mounted boom sprayer.
chemical_interventions.application_timing: Apply at the first appearance of rectangular lesions on lower canopy, before infection reaches the ear leaf.
chemical_interventions.growth_stage_restrictions: Do not apply during full pollination or within 21 days of harvest.
ppe_requirements: Wear chemical-resistant gloves, safety mask, and goggles
chemical_interventions.environmental_precautions: Do not spray near fish ponds or open irrigation water.

chemical_interventions.verification_source: State Agricultural Universities Crop Protection Guidelines (Check local state restrictions)
chemical_interventions.application_timing: Curative spray at onset of rectangular lesions.
chemical_interventions.growth_stage_restrictions: Do not apply more than once per season to prevent pathogen resistance.
chemical_interventions.environmental_precautions: Follow strict water hazard safety warnings.

integrated_disease_management: Rotate crops: Cercospora fungus overwinters exclusively in corn residue; crop rotation breaks pathogen cycle.
Incorporate or destroy infected stubble post-harvest to reduce fungal sporulation source.
Ensure recommended plant spacing to avoid dense canopy humidity traps.
Plant resistant maize hybrids recommended for your agro-climatic zone.

symptom_distinction.en: Normal green foliage with no active fungal or bacterial lesions.
symptom_distinction.te: తెగుళ్ల లక్షణాలు లేని ఆరోగ్యకరమైన ఆకు పచ్చని మొక్క.

integrated_disease_management: No chemical or fungicide application is needed or recommended.
Maintain periodic scouting every 7–10 days across multiple field locations.
Ensure balanced soil-tested fertilization and avoid water stagnation.
Monitor weather forecasts for sudden high-humidity or continuous overcast windows.
